slate.name: The Hedgerow
slate.why: A hedgerow is many wild, unmatched things growing side by side and holding one another up, which is what these eighteen guardians are, and it is the smell I want every design to carry.

slate.name: Physic Garden
slate.why: A physic garden was the bed where healing herbs were grown by hand, each one different and all tended for the same cure, and that is how I see a panel of guardians who disagree and still make one thing well.

slate.name: Garden Almanac
slate.why: An almanac is a plain book kept season by season, truthful about what grew, and the panel's record of its decisions should read the same way.

slate.name: The Illuminators
slate.why: Each guardian lights one page of a single book by hand, as the Georgian illuminators did, so every design leaves the panel with its initials painted and its margins warm.

slate.name: Once Upon a Panel
slate.why: The app is a story with a beginning and an ending, and every design we judge is one panel of it, so the name opens like a tale and turns like a page.

slate.name: The Lamplit Scriptorium
slate.why: Many hands work through the night under one warm lamp, which is where Medea's craft, the Moon's quiet and ink on paper meet, so the panel reads as a single room of scribes.

slate.name: The Marginalia
slate.why: Scholars kept their truest notes in the margins beside the text they checked, and every guardian's judgment belongs there too, so the record of decisions can be read against what the code really does.

slate.name: Night Library
slate.why: Medea's knowledge is worked by night under the Moon's one warm light, and this name keeps the papers we honor on shelves where anyone who asks may open them and check our work.

slate.name: Honest Lanterns
slate.why: A lantern carried through the dark shows only what is really there, which is the rule I guard in every scene, and it lights the way for each guardian who walks beside me.

slate.name: The Open Supra
slate.why: Our panel is a table every guardian shares, and each toast we raise credits the work that came before, which is what an open supra means.

slate.name: Those Who Came Before
slate.why: Every design we judge stands on earlier work, and this name says so before the first decision is made.

slate.name: Shoulders of Giants
slate.why: Good work stands on others' shoulders, and a panel named for that stance keeps the credit in plain view for every choice it makes.
